PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Library Board of

action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Chair
reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up

minutes_text:
MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, JANUARY 22, 2024 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chair Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:00 a.m. in the Barth
Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chair Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl (arrived at 8:05 a.m.), Alternate Wu (arrived at
  8:08 a.m.), Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Domier

  ABSENT: Trustee Derry

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIR REPORT

Chair Domier shared his excitement for the upcoming events going on at the Library including the
Open House on January 27, joint Library Board and City Council meeting on February 23, and
Delicious Destinations on March 16. He reminded the Board of responsibilities of good members,
including informing staff in case of an absence, reviewing the packet thoroughly, attending meetings
of affiliated groups, talking to others in the community to promote the library and receive feedback,
and visiting the Library whenever possible.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Trustee Osegueda thanked the Library for the special collaboration that allowed Carver Library to
loan 62 books. She also thanked the Library for donating encyclopedias that were weeded from the
Crowell Public Library’s collection to Carver Library.

Vice Chair Sadun acknowledged a generous donation from Steve Domier to the Crain Art Gallery.

Alternate Wahl shared that she attended the Noon Year’s Eve program where there was a ball drop
for kids.

Trustee Chien did not have anything to report.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
JANUARY 22, 2024  PAGE 2 OF 3

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

Vice Chair Sadun shared that the exhibit of Emily Sunez’ oil paintings ended on December 15, and
the Committee received a donation check from her. She shared that the current exhibit of large
photographs is called A Flower’s Tale of a Thousand Years by the Chinese Floral Arts Foundation;
there is a reception scheduled on February 3. She shared that the following exhibit will be managed
by the San Marino Public Library Foundation, as it will be on display during Delicious Destinations.
She shared that the Committee has been advertising the availability for artists on social media, but
so far, no exhibits have been finalized.

4. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
No report was given at this time.

5. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Chien shared that the Bookmark Contest received 71 entries. She also shared that the
Foundation has been working very hard preparing for Delicious Destinations, which has been
determined to be priced at $175 per person.

NEW BUSINESS

6. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Vice Chair Sadun moved, seconded by Trustee Osegueda, to approve the minutes of the regular
meeting of November 27, 2023.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Derry

7. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

JANUARY 22, 2024  PAGE 3 OF 3

8. DEVELOPMENT OF AGENDA FOR THE JOINT MEETING WITH CITY
  COUNCIL

Director Johnson presented the staff report.

Trustee Osegueda and Vice Chair Sadun requested a review of part-time salary and benefits.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Trustee Chien, to select Adjust Library Evening Hours,
Video Surveillance System at Community Services Campus, Develop a Deferred Maintenance Plan
for the Library, and Review Compensation Model / Packet for Part-Time Staff to Increase Retention
as priority topics of discussion for the Joint City Council and Library Board of Trustees meeting on
Friday, February 23.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Alternate Wahl, Trustee Chien, Trustee Osegueda, Vice Chair Sadun, Chair Dornier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Derry

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

Chair Dornier adjourned the meeting at 9: 13 a.m.
